name: @oktopeak/lawmatics-mcp
description: Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects Claude to Lawmatics legal CRM. 30+ tools covering matters, contacts, companies, pipelines, tasks, events, notes, tags, custom fields, intake forms, and invoices. Config-level read-only mode and a local audit log, built for law firms. Built by Oktopeak.

scripts.lint:version-sync: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const s=require('./server.json');if(p.version!==s.version)throw new Error('Version mismatch: package.json='+p.version+' server.json='+s.version)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint:version-sync && npm test && npm run build

author: Oktopeak <office@oktopeak.com> (https://oktopeak.com)
